[refund-rules-v2.md:1] # Refund rules
[refund-rules-v2.md:3] ## Who may ask
[refund-rules-v2.md:5] A customer may ask for a refund within 30 days of delivery.
[refund-rules-v2.md:7] ## How much
[refund-rules-v2.md:9] The whole order is refunded, less the delivery fee.
[refund-rules-v2.md:10] Northwind Pay returns the money to the card the order was paid with.
